International Student Office
Non-EU citizens residing abroad who require a Study Visa must submit a B2-level Italian language certificate for admission to Sapienza’s degree programmes taught in Italian.
For additional information for the 2027-2028 academic year, please visit the Italian Language Test for International Students page.

For specific Bachelor’s and Master’s degree programmes taught in English or Italian, candidates must complete an online pre-selection via the MoveIN platform to obtain a pre-acceptance letter. For further details, please visit the Programmes in English page.

Please Note: A positive pre-selection outcome does not guarantee enrolment . Pre-selected students must complete all steps outlined in the Call for Applications for their chosen course and submit all mandatory documents (see point 3 for Bachelor’s/Single-cycle degrees and point 4 for Master’s degrees) to the Hello - International Student Office .
3. Mandatory documents for enrolment – Bachelor’s degree courses and Single-cycle degree courses

The Hello - International Student Office will subsequently schedule in-person appointments to perform an in-depth verification of the documents submitted online and confirm their authenticity. Candidates must bring the original hardcopies of all required documents when summoned.
The following documents must be submitted to the Hello - International Student Office :
11-year system: Academic transcript confirming the successful completion of the first year of university.
10-year system: Academic transcript confirming the successful completion of the first two years of university.

Verification Rights: The Hello - International Student Office reserves the right to verify the authenticity of all documents and request additional documentation to confirm entry requirements, in accordance with Ministry of University and Research (MUR) policies .
Original University qualification and Transcript of Records , with official sworn translations (Italian or English).
Statement of Verification (for both degree and transcript) issued by CIMEA or, alternatively, legalisation/Apostille on original and translated versions. (See competent authorities for Apostille ).
Declaration of Value (DoV) issued by the competent Italian Diplomatic Mission, with legalisation/Apostille on all versions of the degree and transcript. (See competent authorities for Apostille ).
All qualifications including Transcripts (original and sworn translation) must be legalised or Apostilled. (See competent authorities for Apostille ).

Submission Deadline: Pre-enrolment applications must be finalized and submitted by June 30, 2026, at 23:59 (Italian time) . This allows the University sufficient time to validate applications before the Embassies/Consulates' deadlines for visa issuance.

Documents: To ensure a quick validation, you must upload the complete set of mandatory documents (see here for Bachelor's/Single-cycle, here for Master's, or this link for the Foundation Year). Candidates for courses requiring pre-selection (see point 2 ) must also upload their mandatory pre-acceptance letter.
Enrolment is finalized only if the candidate follows all procedures in the Call for Applications and submits all mandatory documents by the set deadline.

In accordance with the official MUR "PROCEDURES FOR ENTRY, RESIDENCY AND ENROLMENT OF INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS AND THE RESPECTIVE RECOGNITION OF QUALIFICATIONS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION COURSES IN ITALY" published at the following link , please note that:

Final Note: If Sapienza is unable to complete the enrolment of an international student due to missing requirements, the relevant Diplomatic Mission will be promptly notified for the immediate cancellation of the entry visa.
6. International students – check your citizenship status
Verification: The Hello - International Student Office reserves the right to verify all documents related to the issuance of your residence permit.

Assessment of Requirements: Book your assessment on Infostud by paying the €10 fee . This can be done from July 2 and not later than September 15, 2026 . Ensure you upload the correct test code as indicated in the Call for Applications.
Administrative Check: Wait for the International Student Office to complete the verification of your documents.
Finalize Enrolment: Complete the process by paying your tuition fees (see point 15 ).

Finalize Enrolment: Once the procedure is complete, finalize your enrolment by paying your tuition fees (see point 15 ).

Admission Requirements:
English Proficiency: Minimum B2 level (CEFR) , proven by an official certificate (e.g., IELTS, TOEFL, CAE) or an online interview organized by the University.

International students who wish to have their previous university career evaluated for a shortening of their degree programme (abbreviazione di corso) must first complete their enrolment for the first academic year in Sapienza.
Complete the application form for degree shortening and pay the €16.00 duty stamp (marca da bollo) online .
Open a ticket for the HELLO - International Student Office via the Ticketing Service , and upload the application form, the duty stamp payment and the below listed documents.
Application Form & Payment Receipt: The duly filled form and the €16.00 duty stamp receipt.
Verification: The Hello - International Student Office will verify the completeness of your documentation before forwarding it to the relevant Faculty Student Affairs Office.
